Subject: Connect your site to HitKeep

Connect your site to HitKeep

Add your site in the dashboard, copy its tracking script into your page, and open it in a browser. Your first visit will appear in the dashboard.

Open dashboard: https://app.hitkeep.example/dashboard

Read the docs: https://hitkeep.com/docs/
